minFollowers.title: Minimum Followers
minFollowers.description: Only include profiles with at least this many followers. e.g. 20000 for 20K+

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: The industry to target. e.g. 'Software Engineering', 'Finance', 'Healthcare', 'Marketing'

maxProfiles.title: Max Profiles to Scrape
maxProfiles.description: Maximum number of qualifying leads to collect.

location.title: Location Filter (optional)
location.description: LinkedIn geoUrn for location filtering (e.g. '103644278' for United States). Leave blank for worldwide.

linkedInCookies.title: LinkedIn Session Cookies
linkedInCookies.description: Your LinkedIn session cookies. At minimum provide 'li_at'. Get these from your browser DevTools → Application → Cookies → www.linkedin.com.
